languageSecurityMappings.admission: Async bytes/stream or explicit VFS capability; no implicit host I/O, network, launch, native runtime or clock.
languageSecurityMappings.ownership: LinkData part and path identify the owning XML part/property; relationship IDs resolve only inside that owning part. Selection tokens retain fingerprint checks.
languageSecurityMappings.absence: Null is explicit absence in read records; undefined only omits options. Read enumeration does not create XML or live proxy getters.
languageSecurityMappings.actions: Navigation supports first/last/next/previous and explicit slide targets. Unsupported actions remain XML data requiring explicit sanitization; no action is ever executed.
languageSecurityMappings.urls: External TargetMode distinguishes URL references, including relative URLs, from package-relative slide relationships. Do not normalize away fragments/query/percent encoding.
languageSecurityMappings.model: Neutral direct model property spellings implemented by ActionSetting/Hyperlink and session-bound LinkShape/LinkRun; existing comprehensive shape/text graph integration remains separate.
